newsitem.title: USA: Smithway Q4 net rises after acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Smithway Q4 net rises after acquisitions.

text.p: Smithway Motor Xpress Corp on Tuesday said its purchase of two trucking companies in January and October 1996 helped boost earnings and revenues in the fourth quarter ended December 31.

The company said fourth-quarter net income rose to $952,000, or $0.19 a share, from $393,000, or $0.11, in the same period of 1995. Total operating revenue climbed to $25.6 million from $19.3 million.
The freight hauler said increased operating efficiencies, solid demand and expanded territories also played a part in the improved performance.
Smithway's shares were up 7/16 at 9-3/8 in early afternoon trading.
